fills.researcher_notes: One question per company, answered once for the whole Okarem-Beyneu/Beyneu-Zhanaozen corridor (P2492 + P5772) and applied to both rows per the brief's instruction (stated explicitly here and on P5772). Kazakh-section operator = АО «Интергаз Центральная Азия», via its Aktau branch (УМГ «Актау»). Sources: (1) intergas.kz's 'General information' page — 'УМГ «Актау»: МГ «Средняя Азия-Центр», МГ «Окарем-Бейнеу» с лупингами, МГ «Бейнеу-Бозой-Шымкент», МГ «Узень-Жетыбай-Актау»' — names UMG Aktau as the branch that operates Okarem-Beyneu 'с лупингами' (with its loopings, which the already-settled cluster-I finding says covers P5772 despite it being filed under P2492's name on GEM). (2) QazaqGaz's KASE-filed 2023 Integrated Annual Report lists 'МГ «Окарем - Бейнеу»' AND 'МГ «Бейнеу - Жанаозен»' as two separate items under 'АО «Интергаз Центральная Азия» осуществляет эксплуатацию следующих магистральных газопроводов' (p.21–22; url_verifier false-negatives on this large PDF, confirmed locally with pdftotext -layout). Marked tier=medium/independent=false rather than high: both sources are ultimately QazaqGaz-group self-reporting (Intergas Central Asia's own site + its parent QazaqGaz's own annual report) — I searched specifically for a third-party (press, EIA/ОВОС hearing, regulator) source naming Okarem-Beyneu's operator directly and did not find one (I did find ecoportal.kz public-hearing material for Intergas Central Asia's Aktau branch generally, but none of the specific hearing pages I could open named Okarem-Beyneu by line name, only the branch).

validity.recommendation: No change needed — Diameter (1020, 1220 mm) is already correct for this row; it's the trans-boundary trunk's own value, separate from P5772's.
validity.researcher_notes: The wiki_alignment flag's union (1000, 1020, 1220 mm / 39.37, 40.16, 48.03 in) is P2492's own two values plus P5772's one value (1000 mm), combined by the multi-segment wiki page — not a per-row omission. No independent source found assigns 1000 mm to P2492 itself.

validity.recommendation: No change needed for Owner or Parent.
validity.researcher_notes: Owner (Turkmengaz; Samruk-Kazyna SWF JSC) already correctly reflects the cross-border split the brief describes — Turkmenistan's state gas company on the Turkmen side, Samruk-Kazyna (QazaqGaz/Intergas Central Asia's ultimate owner) on the Kazakh side — consistent with the Operator finding above. The wiki's union with 'qazaqgaz' is simply P5772's own wholly-domestic Owner value combined in via the multi-segment page, not a defect. Parent (Samruk-Kazyna SWF JSC; Turkmengaz) uses the immediate corporate parent (Turkmengaz) rather than the wiki's 'Government of Turkmenistan' one level further up the ownership chain — a level-of-hierarchy choice, not a conflict; both readings are legitimate and I found nothing to prefer one over the other, so left as-is.
